name: so.growthgenie/growth-genie-docs
title: Growth Genie Docs
description: Search and read the Growth Genie docs: MCP tools, OAuth, scopes, errors and the CLI. No sign-in.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Growth Genie documentation (the MCP server and its tools, the API: OAuth, scopes, limits and error codes, and the CLI) by keywords. Returns the best-matching sections, best first, each with its page title, heading, a link to the section and a snippet. Pass a result's path to read_doc for the whole page.

query.description: Keywords, for example "refresh token" or "rate limit 429".

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one page of the Growth Genie documentation as Markdown. path is the page's path from search_docs or list_docs ("/mcp/"), or its full address; an anchor is ignored.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List every page of the Growth Genie documentation with its path, address, title, description and section headings.
